name: Differentiable DRR with Post-Processing Normalization and Inversion
definition: A differentiable volume rendering technique for DRR generation that correctly propagates gradients through post-render normalization and inversion by applying the vector-Jacobian product (VJP) at the Python/CUDA boundary, preventing gradient sign flips and anti-convergence in 2D/3D registration.
summary: This method corrects gradient computation in differentiable DRR pipelines by explicitly handling post-rendering normalization and inversion, ensuring convergence in 2D/3D registration.
